goal: For every verification gate in the runtime, say whether a pull request can change the check that judges it, so the exposed ones can be protected (H13) before any gate moves to enforce.
changed: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md has an audit table with one row per gate across the five repos: where its code and config come from at PR time, whether main requires it, who can change it, and a fix or owner.
Ten of the twelve rows answer "the PR". The two ledger-verify rows don't, with one untested gap.
No workflow, ruleset or pin changed.

claims.claim: Each cell not marked inferred or untested matches the workflow files on each repo's main and GitHub's ruleset or branch protection settings as of 2026-11-21.
claims.check: Read every file under .github/workflows/ on origin/main in the five repos, and each repo's rulesets and branch protection with gh api. One reader, no second pass.
claims.remaining: The kept output covers the three public repos only. The check-product.py and receipts rows are inferred from the playbook text, since no workflow runs them.

claims.claim: A pull request cannot get past a pull_request_target check by adding a second job with the same name.
claims.remaining: Nobody has tried a pull request where the base-branch run fails and a same-named run passes. agent-ledger pull requests already carry two ledger-verify check runs, one skipped.

claims.claim: make check and make validate pass with the new section.
claims.check: make check && make validate on macOS under Python 3.12
claims.remaining: Linux, which this pull request's CI run covers.

next.item: H13: protect workflow files and checker pins, starting with the books and change-record checks
next.why_now: It was waiting on this table. The table also shows a code-owner review can't do it alone, because agents open pull requests as the owner's account.
next.impact: Until then a pull request to either books repo can swap the checker pin or drop a flag in the same diff the check judges, and still merge green.

next.item: Test the name gap once on a scratch pull request
next.why_now: Every "not the PR" row rests on it, and it takes one throwaway pull request.
next.impact: If a same-named passing job satisfies a required check, ledger-verify is not out of reach either, and H13 needs a different fix.

next.item: Keep change-record in observe in all four repos
next.why_now: The check is a day old, and in every repo the pull request can edit the flag, the pin or the checker itself.
next.impact: Enforcing now would block honest docs pull requests while stopping nobody who edits the workflow.

next.item: R29 units 2 and 3: the probe-edit check and the test guard
next.why_now: They are the named fix for five rows: the receipts and check-product rows, and the tests behind validate and both test checks.
next.impact: A diff that edits a probe and ticks its box, or deletes a test, gets reported instead of passing unseen.

release.none: Docs only: an audit table. Nothing a user of the kit runs has changed.
